title: Towards wearable-scale, transition-aware sleep staging for clinical populations
abstract: arXiv:2611.21040v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Automatic sleep staging models are predominantly developed on healthy sleepers and generalize poorly to clinical populations with fragmented sleep. Across three cohorts (patients with stroke, isolated REM sleep behaviour disorder, and other sleep disorders), we observe 2-3x more awakenings per hour, nearly twice as much N1, and less REM sleep than in healthy sleepers. We propose a label-efficient teacher-student framework for wearable-scale sleep staging. SleepGPT (136M parameters), adapted using labels from 25% of training patients, supervises a causal CNN-GRU (31k parameters; 122 KB) that stages EEG, EOG, or both in real time. We introduce Gcv-TAD, a new black-box transition-aware distillation loss. It emphasizes uncommon stage transitions while discounting those that vary across patients, using a prior estimated from labelled patients. translated_title: 迈向面向临床人群的可穿戴尺度、转换感知的睡眠分期
translated_abstract: 自动睡眠分期模型主要基于健康睡眠者开发，对具有碎片化睡眠的临床人群泛化能力较差。通过三个队列（中风患者、孤立性快速眼动睡眠行为障碍患者及其他睡眠障碍患者）的研究，我们观察到这些患者每小时的觉醒次数是健康睡眠者的2-3倍，N1期睡眠几乎多出一倍，而REM睡眠则更少。我们提出了一种标签高效的师生框架，用于可穿戴尺度的睡眠分期。SleepGPT（1.36亿参数）仅使用25%训练患者的标签进行适配，并据此监督一个因果CNN-GRU模型（3.1万参数；122 KB），该模型可实时对脑电（EEG）、眼电（EOG）或两者同时进行睡眠分期。我们提出了Gcv-TAD，一种新的黑盒转换感知蒸馏损失。它利用从有标签患者中估计的先验分布，强调不常见的睡眠阶段转换，同时降低那些在不同患者间变异性较大的转换的权重。在按患者划分的10折交叉验证中，Gcv-TAD相较有监督训练提升了每患者的宏平均F1分数。
tldr: 该研究针对睡眠碎片化的临床人群，提出标签高效的师生蒸馏框架：以仅用25%患者标签适配的SleepGPT为教师，通过新型转换感知蒸馏损失Gcv-TAD，训练出仅122KB、可实时运行的可穿戴睡眠分期模型，显著提升临床人群分期性能。
en_tdlr: The study proposes a label-efficient teacher-student framework in which SleepGPT, adapted with labels from only 25% of patients, distills into a 122 KB real-time wearable sleep staging model via a novel black-box transition-aware distillation loss (Gcv-TAD), markedly improving staging for clinical populations with fragmented sleep.
